mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect a temperature of 67 degrees under foggy conditions near the Military Ridge State Trail. We are currently under a new moon phase.

City Hall reminds residents that road construction is slated to begin August 18 on Highway M, which will shift traffic patterns for the next few weeks. Also, the Senior Center is seeking volunteers to assist with their local programs.

There is plenty to enjoy this weekend, starting with live music at Bailey's Run today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch music at Paddy Mac's, and the fun continues with the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds on August 16.
On August 6, an officer conducted a traffic stop where a 49-year-old driver was arrested for an O W I, fourth offence, following erratic driving.
You can enjoy the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor of the day once the shop opens at 10 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be Turtle flavor.
